portedFromTheOracle.chart: src/renderer.js drawDiveProfileChart(): no chart below two samples; depth scaled to the deepest sample (at least 1 m) and time to the dive's length (at least a minute); a grid line every 10 m; the depth polyline; the ceiling polyline only where the ceiling is above 0, in separate runs; a marker per diveEvents entry at the depth of the sample nearest its time, the skipped stop at the last sample's time at 5 m, red for violations and amber for the skipped stop; 0 m, the deepest depth and the dive time as axis labels; the chart drawn after the safety-stop warning, inside a 4 px inset.
portedFromTheOracle.text: The axis labels use the locale formatters; postDive.profile* (en, de) names the chart, its legend and its text alternative; postDive.profile.*, which names the deco ceiling, is anchored under DECOMPRESSION-001.

departuresInPresentation: The lines are an SVG stretched to the screen's width with non-scaling strokes; labels and markers are HTML over it, so they stay round and legible at 320 px. Markers carry the number of their entry in the violations list, in its order, and the ceiling is dashed, so neither rests on colour alone (docs/decisions.md, Accessibility). The plot is one role=img with a sentence naming the dive's length, depth, deepest ceiling and number of marks; the legend is aria-hidden as that sentence carries it. The chart sits below legacy's SIMULATION boundary line (#227), which stays whole on the first screen.
browserChecks: tests/post-dive.spec.js: on the completed dive, the chart's accessible name (25 min 30 sec, deepest 18 m, no ceiling, 2 marks), the axis labels 0 m, 18 m and 25 min 30 sec, one grid line, one depth line and no ceiling, markers numbered 1 and 2 in the list's order at legacy's positions (the fast ascent at 1440 of 1530 s across and 60% down, the skipped stop at the end at 5 of 18 m, compared with toBeCloseTo), and the chart below the boundary line; on a resumed completed save with its stop done and a 2 m ceiling over two stretches of the hold, two ceiling runs from their first sample to their last at 2 m on the 18 m scale, 'The deco ceiling reached 2 m.' and one mark; at 844 x 390 and 667 x 375 in English and German, the boundary line whole without scrolling, the chart below it, and the #120/#121 layout checks; the boundary line whole (ratio 1) at the desktop size, 390 x 844 and 320 x 568, where the chart's name is also checked in English and German.
